I'm so glad this ended up being an Inventory rift instead of the usual kind. Instead of facing great peril in the Still World, I can simply relax; meet interesting people; maybe learn some new echoes...
Thank the Goddesses this turned out to be a mere Inventory rift... You're all a lot friendlier than the dark monsters of the Still World.

Logically speaking, echoes make the perfect sexual aid for an unwed princess. All the advantages of a real, live partner -- yet they are fully loyal, exist only when you need them, and cannot get you pregnant! Not to mention the sheer variety of physiologies to enjoy...!

To be wholly frank, most of my sexual experience comes from echoes. It's only responsible, after all -- sleeping with a real man could lead to bearing his child, but echoes lack that risk! Of course, the anatomical variety is also pleasant in its own right...

Any given echo's utility may not be obvious at first glance, but it always pays to experiment. Some excel in combat, others aid in travel, and still more provide great sexual relief -- but that's just scratching the surface of all the possibilities!
Whether slaying foes, traversing rough environs, or granting sexual relief, echoes have all kinds of uses -- and not always the ones you might expect. That's why experimentation is crucial!

When it comes to wielding the Tri Rod, I've found that experimentation is crucial. Whether for combat, travel, sexual relief, or other tasks, there is always at least one echo that proves highly effective -- but not always the one you expect!

If used cleverly, even the unlikeliest echoes can provide surprising utility. Of course, whether for combat, travel, or sexual relief, one is sure to choose favorites -- but a newly-learned echo is always worth some thorough experimentation!
Although mixed apple smoothies contain other fruits as well, Electro Apples are of course the star ingredient. Truth be told, though, Electro Apples taste even better in the pies Impa bakes!
All Zora everywhere love music -- but they can sometimes be a little too zealous over it. Be thankful that you've never had to listen to Kushara and Dradd bicker over their preferred styles...

I've considered learning a musical instrument before, but I'm not certain which would suit me best... An ocarina, maybe? Perhaps a pan flute? Or it could be fun to brood ominously over a pipe organ...
Echoes may look -- and mostly behave -- like the real thing. But in truth, they are simply temporary magical constructs... Lacking true will, they are driven solely by the wishes of their creator.

I'm looking forward to learning as many echoes as I can to~background.time~... Turns out that I don't need to kill people to make them drop their shimmer -- I can simply defeat them in contests like this one! Lucky you, no?

For the longest time, I avoided trying to learn echoes from people -- but it turns out I don't need to kill anyone to do so. Besting them in contests works just as well! In other words... If this game goes well for me, I may very well learn yours.

Historically, Hyrule as a kingdom has been beset by much misfortune -- but through sound judgement and swift action, we have persevered. No doubt we shall overcome this rift crisis just like any other.
In my travels, I've learned that it's worryingly easy to forget where you left your horse. Thank the Goddesses that mine always comes running for carrots...

Are there any fellow pot enthusiasts around here...? How would you rate them? Personally, I find Gerudo pots the prettiest, standard pots the comfiest to hide in, and Hyrule Castle pots the most cathartic to smash!
The folks of Suthorn Village tell me that Link assists them with many problems -- from monsters to weeds. There's nothing quite like a man who'll always lend a helping hand, is there?
Sigh... Come to think of it, I've spent less time in the presence of the real Link than I have battling Null's echoes of him. I hope the two of us can get to know each other properly someday soon...
My horse has taken quite a shine to the flag races at Hyrule Ranch, hasn't she...? I should bring her there for her daily exercise more often.

Strip poker is not widely played in Hyrule -- but I've heard that in Hytopia, its popularity eclipses traditional poker! Of course, that kingdom is famous for its love of all things fashion, so it's not wholly surprising...

Heh heh... I've gotten quite good at sleeping around. It doesn't matter if it's the graveyard, the top of Holy Mount Lanayru, or the middle of Hyrule Castle Town on market day -- you name a place, I'll take a nap there!
Oh, hey -- didn't see that pot behind ~player~ until just now. I wonder if I can hit it at this distance...?

All the pots in Hyrule Castle were clearly made with love and great effort.
{tri}Really? I've seen you smash quite a few.{!reset}

The Deku Scrubs go through trends so quickly... Imagine if strip poker became their next big thing.
{tri}That sounds like it would be a disaster.{!reset}
Ha! I know, right?

Hrrrm... If Null can make an imposter Ganon, then that means the real one must be trapped in the Still World somewhere. Vanquishing Null must be done, but... to think that freeing the Demon King is now the lesser evil...
The Tri Rod can make echoes of food, but it never tastes quite right... I've found that monsters and horses don't care, but most people -- and cats -- are pickier.
Most of Hyrule's neighbors have been very helpful in this time of crisis. Once all the rifts have been sealed, we should strengthen our diplomatic ties and build a more formal alliance...
Do you ever walk into a town for the first time, see a jail, and just know that you'll have to break out of it at some point? Perhaps that is just a "me" thing...

I must admit I've only barely met Link firsthand -- but I've learned quite a lot about him! He's a hard worker. He'll always assist those in need. He doesn't lock his door when he goes out. His bed is cozy and smells pleasant...
If you're ever in need of combat training, I wholeheartedly recommend the Slumber Dojo. Training while you sleep may sound a bit sketchy, true -- but Shisho's methods get real results!

I bet the Great Fairy would be fascinated by all the different fashions here... She loves making people more stylish, after all!
{tri}Maybe. But she'd rather see people put on more accessories than take them off...{!reset}
I should pay another visit to Condé at the next opportunity. That big fluffball must get lonely all by himself on Hebra Mountain...

On occasion, I've watched General Wright's men play cards while off duty -- but they'd never let me join in! Allegedly, getting caught teaching the Princess to gamble would earn them the scolding of a lifetime...

People often get pulled into rifts while they're doing the oddest things...! For example, during one trip to the Still World, I saw a man petrified with his pants around his ankles and his fist up his --
{tri}Zelda, please don't remind me.{!reset}

Sea Zoras are always praised for their beauty -- and rightly so! -- but they cannot beat River Zoras for raw sexual magnetism. Those stout, scaly bodies; those spiny head-fins; those smoochable lips... Mmmmm, so wet...

One of the scariest things about Null is that the more people and monsters it acquires, the more imposters it can create to do its bidding. And yet... I suppose that is also one of the scariest things about me!

Impa worries that I might be overextending myself for the sake of the kingdom... and I do appreciate that she's concerned for me. But if anything, all this freedom and adventure has left me feeling never better!

Did you know that across the ages, which creatures should be classified as "monsters" has been the subject of much debate? Even Deku Scrubs and River Zoras were once considered monsters before their cultures made peace with Hyrule.

Oh, I should ask -- I don't look like I'm talking to thin air, do I? Normally, only people who have been through a rift can see or hear Tri!
{tri}Well, we did enter a rift to get here. So they can probably see me...? {!reset}
Say, want to hear a secret...? Hyrule Castle contains a number of hidden passages known only to the royal family. There's even one hidden beneath the throne!

Potions are well-known for their restorative properties -- so it was a shock to discover that they're actually less effective than many types of smoothie. Perhaps Hyrule's potion-brewing industry is in need of reform...
The remains of many great castles and temples can be found throughout Hyrule. 'Tis humbling to reflect on how time grinds even the mightiest works to dust...
You know, I'm something of a culinary pioneer among the Deku Scrubs... Visit any smoothie shop across the land of Hyrule and you'll find that every recipe on their menu was introduced by yours truly!

Dohna seemed quite pleased that we now have matching sets of pajamas... I should invite her to stay overnight at the castle sometime. I've never had a sleepover before, but they sound most fun indeed...!
Every so often, I find guards napping at their posts -- but I usually don't report them. True, I may be a princess, but I've also had to sneak into my own castle before, so...
A certain shopkeeper confessed to me their worries about spies from competing item shops. To think that business in Hyrule could be so cutthroat...
During my time as a fugitive, few of Hyrule's citizens believed that I was truly responsible for the rifts... To know that my people placed such faith in me did much to bolster my spirits.

{tri}You seem distracted, Zelda... Are you still wondering what that cotton candy tasted like?{!reset}
...Hm? Well, the Deku Scrubs made it look so tasty. But I never got the chance to find out for myself...
{tri}Zelda. It was made from Gohma webs.{!reset}
Nevertheless!
Some monsters like to lurk in tall grass to ambush their prey, but that's dealt with easily enough. Just set the grass on fire and watch the monsters roast!
I've been told that Kushara and Dradd are old childhood friends, but these days, they find it all too easy to argue over every little thing... I swear, those two need to just fuck already.

Not all monsters are hostile... Some simply wish to be left alone. For example, I've heard that certain Moblins will give you rupees if you find their cave -- so long as you keep it a secret to everybody!
Horses are beautiful and majestic, and I simply adore riding them, yet... I cannot deny that most of the time, 'tis far more convenient to simply warp between waypoints.
If anyone here enjoys spicy foods, I cannot recommend Gerudo cooking enough. Warm Peppers are a key ingredient, so it treats you to a truly chill-proof heat!
Have you ever taken a good, long look at a Riverhorse...? Those mouths of theirs truly are distinctive.
I may not look it, but I'm actually quite strong. Rocks are child's play -- I can even carry Darknuts over my head without breaking a sweat!

In my experience, the company of Deku Scrubs is... best taken in small doses. Spend too much time around shallow, egocentric creatures who think they're cute and trendy and you'll start to consider the merits of arson.
Here's a neat trick for dealing with monsters: if it's not already swimming, it probably can't. Simply drop it into a nearby body of water and it'll drown in no time at all!
Gorons use rocks to make more or less anything... Their food; their artwork; even their beds! One could say that it forms the bedrock of their society.
I'm not nearly as big a fan of stamps as some people. But if getting roped into a stamp rally has taught me anything, it's that there is indeed something satisfying in a good, solid plunk.
I just realized -- the Deku Scrubs don't even have an official ruler, do they? Oh, that's weird.

Few are the problems that have only one possible solution. For example, if one needed to scale a cliff, one could build a staircase out of beds; Reverse Bond to a Crawltula; conjure a Platboom -- or even look for an existing path to the top!

As an avid student of all forms of wisdom, I was quite pleased that Darston was willing to share with me the Goron Chief's 56 Nuggets of Wisdom -- unabridged. Perhaps I may get the chance to employ some to~background.time~!

In a way, a cock-and-balls embodies the domains of the three Goddesses. The cock stands for power; the left ball, wisdom; and the right, courage!
{tri}...Um. Zelda? I don't think that's even a little true.{!reset}
No, but truly think about it!
{tri}Have you truly thought about it...?{!reset}
From any angle, I am a vision to behold... Don't you agree, ~player~?
Goodness me... I am in quite the vulnerable state, am I not? I hope I can count on you to watch my back.
Hmmmm. Most women never get the chance to inspect their own nethers, do they? Or at least not up close, without a mirror. Even I can only do it by summoning an echo of myself…
If anyone sees an unusual patch of dirt nearby, please do inform me. I'll conjure a Holmill to do some digging!
I wonder if there are any Might Crystals around here. It's not too rare to find one under a rock or in a patch of thick grass... Although perhaps that only holds true in Hyrule.
I know that we're well beyond Hyrule at this point, but I would not put it past the Stamp Guy to somehow erect a stamp stand in another world... I'd better take a look around after the game.

{tri}The people at the castle keep telling you that "You were always a spirited girl"... Do they mean that you're like ~ghost~?{!reset}

Say... Why is that throne empty, anyway? Is the reigning monarch absent? Or is this game to decide who shall rule?
I would bet fifty rupees that there's a secret passage hidden beneath that throne... I mean, it's a classic for a reason!
I'm a pretty skilled swimmer, if I may say so myself -- and that counts double for deep diving. When I go down, I don't need to come up for air for a loooooong time!

Even if you don't feel at home in the water, there are plenty of items that can help you swim faster or hold your breath longer. Zora's Flippers; Zora Scales; smoothies made with Bubble Kelp or Riverhorse...
Rapid smoothies are great for enhancing one's swim speed, but one can't forget about the taste, either. There's nothing quite like the unmistakable flavor of fresh Riverhorse!
Mmmm... There's nothing quite like the unmistakable flavor of fresh Riverhorse. It's a good thing it's so widely known, because no description could do it justice!

{tri}When people get pulled into rifts, they kind of... petrify and can't move anymore. And if they stay that way? They'll eventually fade away.{!reset}
That's why if you ever see a rift around here, you should keep your distance!

Huh... Even if someone ends up in the Still World, their petrified body could still be fucked, could it not? Of course, actually doing so would be highly unethical -- unless they agreed to it beforehand, I suppose.
My father is the very model of an ideal king -- warm of heart, quick of wit, and iron of will! I hope that when I someday take the throne, I prove no less capable a ruler.

General Wright may be stubborn and hot-headed at times, but our soldiers look up to him for a reason. His courageous spirit and his strong sense of duty toward protecting the people of Hyrule are quite inspiring!

Minister Lefte works diligently to keep Hyrule's government running smoothly, and she's always so polite and helpful... She's also low-key a babe, so it's a wonder how she's still single. Perhaps she's married to the job?

Mrrrrm... Impa may be a capable fighter even at her advanced age, but the years will only continue to slow her down. Here's hoping her role as my caretaker will become less perilous than it has been as of late...

Lueburry may be rough around the edges, but he possesses quite the brilliant mind! The weaponry he's forged from Might Crystals have greatly aided in combating the rifts -- first in Link's hands; now in mine.

Hmmm... Despite the intensity of their rivalry, Dradd and Kushara are more alike than not. Given their committment to peace and prosperity between the River and Sea Zoras, I'd say that reflects well on them.

The genius inventor, Dampé, has crafted many an automaton to help me on my adventures! Granted, rarely do I have reason to actually use them in place of my echoes -- but they are quite impressive nonetheless.
If you ever find yourself on Hebra Mountain, I recommend visiting the home of Condé. I should note, he is a yeti -- but he's also a sweet and gentle soul who could never have too many friends.

'Tis a shame that Dohna is not here to~background.time~... I'm sure you all would love her. Ever since I saved her from a monster attack, she has been the truest, most loyal friend that one could ask for!
As a ruler, Chief Seera leads the Gerudos with a cautious yet rational perspective. But more to the point, she is also a smoking hot dommy mommy! Needless to say, I am quite the fan.

Oh, by the way... If you ever run into someone who looks like me but acts all hostile and eerie, that's not me -- that's an imposter created by Null to further their malign plans. Go ahead and wreck her holes all you want.

So, apparently, the blue monster who kidnapped me for a week was named Ganon...? The Demon King, or... something like that. Of course, he turned out to be an imposter, so I'm not sure how much it truly matters...
Say, ~boobs~... If I were to conjure a trampoline, might you be interested in bouncing on it? I ask for no particular reason.
You know, ~boobs~... Your quite impressive breasts would surely be even more majestic in motion! If I were to conjure a trampoline, would you be interested in bouncing on it?
Want to hear a secret? Spinning in circles is not merely a convenient way to trim grass or harvest mangos. 'Tis also quite fun!
This is some lovely grass around us...! Nice and short. If I see any patches of grass that's grown long, I find it hard to resist the urge to trim it. Or burn it down.
The very strongest Moblins have blue skin -- and so does Ganon. I wonder if there's any correlation there...?
Deku Babas are among the more common plant monsters, but they're easy to conquer if you know the trick. Just grab the head and tug it off!
Bombfish truly are the best... It's a bomb. It's a fish. What more could you possibly ask for?

There's nothing quite like conjuring a Zirro to spit a rain of bombs at your foes -- but I must admit I find them somewhat baffling. I mean, it's a flying mushroom. How does it even produce those bombs?
Wolfos may resemble wolves superficially, but in truth, they're every bit as clever as your average Hylian. We wouldn't call them "-fos" if they weren't!
Lynels are utterly breathtaking, are they not? The strength and beauty of a horse; the ingenuity of a man; the majestic savagery of a lion...
When traveling Gerudo Desert, be careful of Arurodas -- burrowing monsters with fearsome stingers. They like nothing more than to sneak up on you and penetrate you from behind!

If you're ever short on rupees, you should do what I do: unleash a swarm of Crows upon your enemies!
{tri}It doesn't sound like it would help. But somehow, it does...{!reset}
When it comes to monsters, Zols are among the cutest. Those blobby little slimes are remarkably charming in their simplicity -- and they come in such variety!
Technically, Buzz Blobs aren't Zols, but they're within the same family. They differ from the common Zol in two notable ways: first, their electrical aura, and second, their vaguely phallic shape!

Moblins are known for being fiercely territorial brutes, but they're also remarkably social and intelligent! They build sturdy structures for their outposts; wield spears, swords, and shields; display fascinating tribal customs...
I don't see why people think Moblins and Boarblins are unsightly. Those piggish noses; those thick tusks; those plump bellies... Every last inch of them is full of cuteness and charm!

Lynels are among the most fearsome monsters in all of Hyrule, but also the rarest... Solitary by nature, they prefer to lair in remote environs. I was incredibly lucky to track one down in the Eternal Forest!

Lizalfos may be one of the most agile monsters around, but you can turn their quickness against them. Trick them into striking a shield or boulder to momentarily stun them -- and then launch your counterattack!
While they prefer to make their homes in warmer climates, Lizalfos are otherwise quite adaptable as a species. The stronger ones are resistant to fire and can even breathe underwater!

The strongest of Darknuts wear armor well beyond what Hylian smiths can produce -- granting them immunity to arrows and blunt-force attacks alike! If only we could learn how to replicate such sturdiness...
While their axe-strikes are powerful indeed, Darknuts make for rather slow-footed minions. Oftentimes, 'tis most efficient to pick them up with Bind and drop them right in front of one's foes.
Due to their similarly shadowy appearances beneath their garb, some scholars posit that Darknuts and Wizzrobes are closely related. This theory has yet to be proven, though...

Ball-and-Chain Troopers are often mistaken for Darknuts, but in truth, they are an entirely separate breed... You can identify a Ball-and-Chain Trooper by its golden armor, red eyes, and the huge fucking ball-and-chain it carries. Duh.
A Ball-and-Chain Trooper's eponymous weapon can shatter plenty of objects with ease. And they hardly need prompting... They're always down to smash!

Before setting a Gibdo on fire, note the color of its bandages... If it's wrapped in white, fire will prove quite potent -- but if it's wrapped in black, burning it will only transform it into a ReDead.
ReDeads may resemble walking corpses in masks, but they were never human to begin with. Granted, that does not make them any less eerie...

Do not underestimate ReDeads just because they shamble so slowly. They'll often move in groups to surround their prey -- and if they paralyze you with their scream, they'll have no trouble closing the distance!
Of all the monsters in Hyrule, Wizzrobes possess the greatest mastery of combat magic. They can fly, teleport, and hurl blasts of elemental energy!
Fire Wizzrobes wear red; Ice Wizzrobes wear blue; and Electric Wizzrobes wear green. How and why they came to that arrangement, I haven't the foggiest.

It's not unheard of for Tornandoes to get mistaken for ghosts... Since they dwell in sandstorms and cloak themselves in whirlwinds, it can be surprisingly difficult to see their true forms. In truth, though, they're actually frog-like monsters!
Remember: a Ribbitune's song summons monsters, while a Drippitune's song summons rain. You do not want to mix those up while trying to save a farmer's crops from drought.

If you happen upon a trail of flame or ice, follow it and you'll likely find one of the most downright adorable monsters around -- a Torch Slug or a Freeze Slug! They emit extreme temperatures to ward off predators.
If a certain monster comes in fire and ice varieties, there's often an electric one, too. But no one's discovered an Electric Octo or Zap Slug... yet. I will find them -- just you wait!
Wolfos fur is the fluffiest, and oh so very warm. If you're camping out under the open stars, there's no better monster to snuggle up against!
Wolfos are pack hunters, known for circling their prey with the intent to confuse and disorient. To those they consider friends and family, though, they are incredibly loyal and affectionate!
Although Keese resemble little more than largeish bats, they're stronger than they look. If you hold one aloft while jumping from a great height, it can safely glide you to the ground!
Keese are one of those monsters that are surprisingly adaptable to the elements... Fire, Ice, and Electric varieties can all be commonly found in their respective biomes.

Mothula fly not just with their wings, but by blasting hot air from its abdomen. Their wings are very pretty, though, and they're a beautiful shade of pink -- so they're a modestly popular subject of embroidery among Hylian women.
Needleflies may just look like giant dragonflies, but they're actually highly intelligent monsters... They'll patiently wait for the perfect opening to pierce you with their tail.
Be careful around Crows... They like to swoop at unsuspecting people to steal their rupees. What's worse, they don't even even purchase anything to keep those rupees circulating through the economy!

Wherever liquid can be found in the wild, Octoroks are often near. The standard type is equally at home in fresh and salt water -- and while they don't like the cold, Ice Octos thrive in frigid water. Even lava can attract Fire Octos!

Unlike what you'd expect from an octopus-like monster, Octorok tentacles are too short and stubby to be any serious threat. It's those mouths you've got to watch out for -- they spit rocks with impeccable aim!
To be entirely honest, Sand Crabs give me the heebie-jeebies. There's one that always mutters to me in my dreams... Even the Sand Crab echoes I summon have started doing it.
I once read about a man who was so terrified that any body of water might be full of Piranhas, he spent his life savings to move to the Gerudo Desert. Poor fucker had never heard about Sand Piranhas.
I've fought Mini-Moldorms before, and they're roughly as large as I am. How much larger would a regular Moldorm be...? Those goofy googly eyes alone must be massive.
The thread spun by a Strandula is only sticky at the ends -- and it's strong enough to hold a person's weight. This makes it excellent for climbing!

True to their name, Crawltulas can crawl on more or less any vertical surface. As such, if you can find a way to stick to one, they make for quite the useful means of vertical transportation! Not quite as useful as Platbooms, of course, but what is?
Tektites are able to distribute their weight so finely that they can hop across the surface of water! If we could somehow find a way to replicate its ability, just imagine the possibilities...

When it comes to fighting monsters, Tektites and Mini-Moldorms are among the most obnoxious... There's patterns to their movements in theory. But somehow, they're so erratic that they'll still slip past your guard!
Be wary of any glowing blue mushrooms you find in the Faron Wetlands. Odds are good that they're attached to a Hoarder -- a beetle-like monster that uses those mushrooms to lure in prey.
Ghinis aren't malevolent ghosts -- they're just lonely. However, they do have a habit of licking potential friends... {small}sometimes to death.{!reset}
I've heard it said that ghosts often linger on due to unfinished business... If that's true, then Poes' unfinished business must be indiscriminate arson.
Why is it that Moas are so protective of their allies, but calm down once those allies are dead? If some knave murdered all my friends, I'd try to kill him even harder.
Certain monsters -- such as Pathblades, Gustmasters, Platbooms, and Beamos -- are commonly mistaken for traps. However, each one's singular eye gives away that they're very much alive.
Physically speaking, a Tweelus is little more than a clump of rocks with limbs. But there's a certain cuteness to that simplicity, is there not?
Being faceless stone and all, Tweeluses don't seem like the type of monster to be tempted by food. But in truth, they simply cannot resist a good Rock Roast!
If you ever fight a Snowmaul, destroying the lower segments of its body won't help for long. If you want to put it down for good, you've got to aim for the head!
Did you know...? While the exact origin of the word "Darknut" is somewhat murky, scholars are largely in agreement that it's a corruption of the phrase "dark knight"!
You should have seen the wanted posters from back when I was on the lam... Actually, never mind. 'Twas almost insulting how poorly they captured my cuteness.

The other day, Falfa told me that -- living at Hyrule Ranch and all -- the only menfolk she sees with regularity are her grandpa, her little brother, and the stallions. 'Tis a good thing she has a steady supply of carrots...
Nothing gets a Goron salivating like rock-hard meat...! That is to say, Rock Roast. 'Tis not nearly as homoerotic as it sounds, sadly.
~monster~ is not the only monster I've met who enjoys games! There was one, Smog, who loved lurking in ruins and luring people into a lethal game of its own devising... Anyway, it's super dead now.
I've heard rumor that through various magics, humans can transform into monsters -- and even vice versa! If the opportunity ever arose, I would very much like to try it myself...

When one's parents are accomplished and beloved, 'tis inevitable that they will one day leave you some very big shoes to fill. Darston knows this all too well, but even Dohna and I have begun to feel it somewhat...

"Nuggets of Wisdom, Number 26: You can't lead from the back!"
That said, I'm sure that you can think of one or two things that can be done from behind...

Back in Hyrule Castle Town, there's this little boy who's utterly fascinated by Zols! Showing him all the different varieties and connecting over the cuteness of monsters has been quite the fulfilling experience... Why, it's helped me feel almost normal.
Back in Hyrule Castle Town, there's this little boy who's utterly fascinated by Zols. 'Tis not hard to predict how that will develop once puberty strikes...

I count my father among the better ones -- but for the people's sake, he must be a good father second and a good king first. With so many affairs of state to handle, he cannot spare as much time for parent-child bonding as we'd both prefer...
Beyond the stories my father and Impa have told me, I have precious few memories of my own mother. Kind eyes; a playful smile; the whispers of a lullaby...
Caromadillos are infamous for curling into a ball and rolling into their foes at great speed. Such a fighting style must sound awfully familiar to some of you, I'm sure!
A Ribbitune's song summons monsters. A Drippitune's song summons rain. But what does ~singer~'s song summon...?
Where you find holes, you're sure to find Holmills! In the ground, that is. I doubt that any hole of ~crotchOut~'s is of any interest to burrowing critters. No offense.
Where you find holes, you're sure to find Holmills! They're just the cutest -- like a potato with whiskers, a pointy snout, and two little legs.
Indeed we are! Tri's and my efforts to repair the rifts across Hyrule and stop them at their source have been a grand adventure so far -- and it will only get more exciting from here!
Is that so? I have no knowledge of this "Earthmate" -- but I am intrigued. Are they as erotic as that title suggests?
More or less! I can create any object I've encountered or any foe I've defeated -- so long as Tri has enough ▲ to spare, of course.

Heh... I know, right? Tri is simply the best!
{tri}It makes sense that such magic is new to you, Reimu. My friends and I don't normally act so visibly -- but the rifts back home have gotten worse lately, so we've had to adapt.{!reset}

The rifts lead to a void known as the Still World... Anyone and anything that enters it becomes petrified, then slowly fades away. The only active denizens of that realm are Null -- who seeks to unmake all creation -- and their dark minions.

Heh... While it comes with its fair share of duties and stress, my life is quite grand on the whole! But I would love to hear more about how you'd use echoes, Jura... If it's within my power, perhaps I could lend you a little bit of that luck to~background.time~.

Well, I do consider myself a lifelong student of wisdom -- and I am proud to gather as many teachers as I can. Should any of your wisdoms prove relevant to~background.time~, do not hesitate to lay them on me!
Oh? First blood on me? Well done, well done indeed!
Ack--! The first very round? Clearly, I must apply myself better...!
Hmm. Well, one of us had to lose first... Might as well be me.

{tri}Another loss? But you're almost naked already...{!reset}
That's true, Tri -- but I have no doubt that I can turn this around.
"Nuggets of Wisdom, Number 34: A breakdown can lead to a breakthrough!"
I see the time has come to shed my cloak... Ah, well. If it can't be helped.
Worry not -- I shan't complain or sulk over such trifling losses as these! As my tutors keep reminding me, a princess must always behave with modesty and decorum.
However many many losses I may suffer, a mere game of cards shan't make me fall into despair. No princess of Hyrule would ever succumb to such a base and vulgar impulse!
I hope it's clear by now that I am no sore loser... As both the princess of Hyrule and the legendary Priestess of Wisdom, I would never act to bring dishonor to my kingdom or my Goddesses.
A loss at this stage is nothing to worry about!

Exactly as planned!
{tri} Zelda, you just lost the round.{!reset}
Indeed, Tri. Which part is confusing you?
Well played, everyone.
Oh? Oh, I see... Yes, this is most assuredly my loss.
'Tis my loss? No matter.
My turn, is it? Very well.
I've no objection to discarding one of my garments. 'Tis only fair, is it not?
Oof -- another heart down! Metaphorically, of course.
No mercy, hmm? You brutes... I approve.

{tri}You lost again? But you're already so close to being naked...{!reset}
Worry not, Tri -- in every crisis, opportunity can be found. I'll take this chance to seize it!
You really will exploit any opening, won't you...? Heh. Yet here am I, about to reveal one or two more.
If you expect my spirit to falter now, I must inform you that Hylian princesses are made of sterner stuff.
This should be easy enough. Compared to thwarting demon kings and primordial abominations, a little full frontal nudity is a breeze! Largely between the nethers.
Ah. Oops.
If this is the Goddesses' will, so be it. I shall strip.

state.text: I cannot call this outcome surprising... But I cannot call it wholly unwelcome, either.

case.state: My turn...? Well, far be it from me to decline a chance to get more comfortable.
You all must want to see me naked pretty badly... Not that I blame you. I am adorable.
Hrm. Clearly, my strategy is in need of some adjustment...

My third loss? Time to take this seriously. The gloves are coming off! Or rather, the... um, foot-gloves? The proper word is on the tip of my tongue.
{tri}Boots?{!reset}
Boots, yes! Thank you, Tri.

You may have scored a few easy wins against me -- but that changes now. The gloves are officially coming off!
{tri}Zelda, you're not wearing gloves.{!reset}
Fuck. Boots it is, then!
Well played indeed! Truly, ~alive~, you have earned a proper look at the rest of me.
With any long undertaking, 'tis crucial to find time to rest and recuperate. And furthermore, this place is teeming with powerful combatants! Learning their echoes would greatly aid me on my quest.

{tri}You've faced Null before? Wait... "She"...?{!reset}
I would be truly glad to have your assistance! When fighting a primordial abomination who seeks to unmake reality, one can never have too much help.

In truth, this cloak technically belongs to Link -- the swordsman who saved me from Ganon's clutches. Of course, he got swallowed up by a rift not long after... Now it's up to me to return the favor by rescuing him.

Strictly speaking, this is not truly my cloak... A hero named Link left it behind when he got swallowed up by a rift after rescuing me. Now I'm working towards saving him -- and stopping the source of the rifts.

My caretaker, Impa, gave me this outfit at the start of my journey. Imposters had taken over the castle and pinned the blame for the rifts on me, so I could hardly walk around Hyrule in my customary attire...

Funnily enough, when imposters steal the throne and declare the princess a criminal, it's troublesome to walk around in public in full royal regalia. That's why my caretaker, Impa, prepared this disguise for me!

For anyone who spends much time in dungeons or the wilds, a pair of nice, sturdy boots is a must! That counts double if you don't have a Tri to warp you between waypoints... Thank you, Tri, by the way.
{tri}I'm glad to help.{!reset}
These boots have left their prints in the sand of Suthorn Beach, the snow atop Holy Mount Lanayru, and everywhere in between. One would be hard-pressed to find another pair more sturdy or reliable!
But enough about that! Who's ready to see some royal titties?
Oh, but never mind all that. You've all earned the right to see two of Hyrule's greatest national treasures: my boobs!

You should hear Minister Lefte's lectures on dignity... "Princess! Could you please try to slay monsters less gruesomely?" "Zelda! A princess should not run around in public while dressed as a cat!" And so on and so forth... Anyway, here are my tits.
On an unrelated note, aren't my panties cute? But just you wait -- here comes the real treat!
I've seen so many rare and wondrous sights since I started my adventure... I'd like to think of this as paying it forward.

You know, before viewing the Prime Energy in person, I never truly noticed just how often it appears in traditional Hylian iconography... 'Tis even on my underthings, for Goddesses' sake. But to be fair, it is quite the visually satisfying motif!
Were I one of the books under Minister Lefte's bed, I might regale you with pretty prattle about the rarest flower in the royal gardens. But even the comeliest cunt is still a cunt, no?

I hope that no one is expecting some frail and delicate flower. I can take a pounding and keep coming back for more!
{tri}It's true. She might not look like it, but Zelda is a very tough combatant.{!reset}
Hm? Oh, yes. That too.
Be sure to appreciate the rarity of the prize you've won. Echoes may be one thing, but the number of real, living people who have so much as glimpsed this part of me can be counted on one hand!
'Tis almost a shame to part with these panties -- they're as comfy as they are cute. Nevertheless, rules are rules...!
Say, has anyone ever told you, "Your body is a temple"? I hear it all the time from Impa and Lefte, but I have no clue what it's actually supposed to mean...
Of course, most of the temples I've encountered have been absolutely stuffed full of monsters... So I suppose I've been doing that part right, at least?
...Hm. Why am I the first to be fully bare...? Mayhaps I was not as prepared as I believed.
...No ruler should be this easy to best. Perhaps, once my quest is over, I should pour more effort into my strategy lessons.
Have I really done so poorly at reading the rest of you...? If Minister Lefte could see me now, she would tell me to review my diplomacy lessons. Or, well. Blush and stammer at me to please cover up.

That said... At a time when moving openly would have been perilous to me, this cloak proved invaluable in concealing my identity. So, in a way... Even now, my hero is still finding ways to protect me!

I look forward to the day when I can return this cloak to my hero -- but at the same time, part of me does not...? Besides the hood's utility in hiding my identity, its weight and scent have been a great comfort to me in these perilous times.

Thankfully, the need for disguises has passed... But it's still rather grown on me. Since it's so light and flowy, it's perfect for adventuring in -- and while it did smell like a musty dresser at first, 'twas nothing a dip in Lake Hylia couldn't solve.

Although I've already solved that little imposter problem, a light, flowy outfit like this one is still perfect for adventuring in -- so long as it's freshly laundered. I spent the first few days of my adventure smelling like a musty dresser, I'm afraid.
Of course, it's also quite lovely whenever I can freely wiggle my toes. So that's one more thing to be thankful for right now!
Still, no matter how comfy one's footwear may be, it can be nice to feel the ~background.surface~ with your own two feet! At least every once in a while, no?
It feels quite freeing to get everything out in the open, doesn't it? If you're all happy to keep a secret, I'll be happy to trust you with a few more.
Well...? Are they to your liking? I know that I am quite fond of them.
To see my bosom fully bared must be truly magnificent, no? 'Tis not for nothing that I am considered one of the most beautiful women in Hyrule!
Flawless, no...? If you're still uncertain, inspect as closely as you must.
What do you think, ~player~ -- beautiful, no? Or would you describe them as "cute" instead?
Hmhm... I graciously accept any and all praise.
Please, stare to your heart's content. Beauty is meant to be appreciated, after all!
On occasion, I've been told that I can be quite the handful -- but that's plain enough to see, no?
Well...? Am I not the cutest?

I may be stripped of my every defense -- but it's only the final heart that truly counts. So long as I don't lose again, I'll win!
{tri} Why are you saying that as if it isn't obvious...?{!reset}
Gaze upon my beauty as much as you desire. After all, what point is there to beauty if not to bring joy to others?
So long as I'm being immodest anyway... Am I not breathtaking to behold? Aside from the Golden Goddesses, there is nary a woman in all of Hyrule who can surpass my beauty!

Behold: the most beautiful woman in all of Hyrule! Although Dohna is also quite gorgeous -- not to mention her mother. And Minister Lefte is cute, too, in her own bookish way. And who could forget Kushara...? Oh! And Falfa, and--
Well, this is me: the Goddesses' favorite princess and the most beautiful girl in Hyrule. Well worth the effort, no?
Everyone back at the castle says that I've always been a spirited girl. True, there are times that call for decorum -- but does it not feel better to simply follow one's nature and live freely?
Look at me now -- free and unburdened! Were it not for the crown, you'd hardly know I was anything but a simple village girl, would you? Hehe...!

Aside from the Prime Energy, before you now is Hyrule's most sacred and untouchable treasure... more's the pity. Echoes are fair game, but if you want the real experience, you must prove yourself worthy.
See? I look cute in anything -- even nothing at all!
Hmmm... I haven't disrobed too quickly, have I? It would be a shame to miss out on learning ~notDead~'s echo...
It seems that chivalry is alive and well... You have my thanks, ~name~.
Impa always warned me about strange men who like to play games with maidens' hearts. But you'll be a perfect gentleman, won't you, ~name~?
Y-yes...! Fuck me just like -- oh, hey! A tie.
Y-yes...! Fuck me just like -- oh, hey! A tie.
Y-yes...! Lick me just like -- oh, hey! A tie.

{tri}That's a tie. What happens now...?{!reset}
What happens, Tri, is that we pretend this whole round never happened. Which is boring, but rules are rules...
Oh? How unexpected.
A tie...? That is quite the rarity!
Evenly matched, neither force can overwhelm the other... The inevitable result: a stalemate.
I suspect that ~clothing.withart~ like yours would be popular with the Deku Scrubs. They tend to love all sorts of new oddities!
Huh. I would have assumed that given the opportunity, most men would be more eager to whip their cocks out...
The Gerudo love finding new ways to enhance their beauty. I’m sure they’d find ~clothing.withart~ like yours quite intriguing!
Your ~clothing~? This is quite the princely offering, ~name~.
Oh...? It seems you have found your heroic spirit, good sir.
Ooh... Looking to display your manly virtues, ~name~? Or simply what’s under your ~clothing~?
I’m glad you're not holding back on my account, ~name~... Even a princess loves to watch a handsome man take his clothes off, you know?
Mmmm... It's not too often that I get the chance to truly savor the masculine form. This is nice.
You have a fine body, ~name~ -- beautiful yet manly. You deserve every chance to display it with pride!
Men don’t normally make a habit of taking off their ~clothing~ around me… But I could definitely get used to this.
I must say, I'm overjoyed to see so much of a cute male specimen like yourself, ~name~. You will show me more, won't you...?
If clothes maketh the man, then this man hath been moderately un-made. Heh.
As beautiful as your ~clothing~ ~clothing.ifPlural(are|is)~, ~name~, I have been looking forward to watching you take ~clothing.ifPlural(them|it)~ off.
That's right, ~name~ – no need to be modest in front of me. I may be a princess, but first and foremost, we’re still both girls!
Don't worry, ~name~! As pretty as you look in ~clothing.ifPlural(those|that)~ ~clothing~, I’m sure you’ll look at least as pretty out of ~clothing.ifPlural(them|it)~.
I know this may be daunting, ~name~, so just remember: Zora women spend their whole lives pussy-out. Compared to that, giving up your ~clothing~ is easy, right?
I’d love to have a copy of ~name~’s ~clothing~, but echoes are too temporary to make wearing them a good idea… I learned that lesson the hard way.
Among the common folk, it’s not uncommon for friends of the same sex to undress around each other, right? Or at least that’s what I’ve heard...
I can appreciate a fair maiden as much as anyone... And ~name~ is giving me much to appreciate.
If it makes you feel better, ~name~, I think you’re looking very pretty right now. And if a princess is saying it, then it must be true!
Is this how bonding between women usually goes…? If so, I kind of wish I had started sooner.

It's never any fun to be a damsel in distress...
Far better, then, to merely be a damsel half-undressed!
Now that I’m seeing more of it, ~name~’s skin looks rather beautiful… I wonder what she does to keep it so smooth and supple.
Baring your chest, ~name~...? By all means, proceed.
As far as men’s bodies are concerned, I'm not too picky. I mean, they're all just so fascinating...
No need to be nervous, ~name~. When it comes to men's bodies, I’m quite easy to please!
Oh...? It seems we've reached the point where playing well starts yielding worthwhile rewards!
I’ll be observing you closely, ~name~... I don’t want to miss a single detail.
Please, ~name~, don’t pay me any mind. I might stare intently as you bare your chest, but that’s merely for my sexual gratification!

They say that the way to a man’s heart is through his stomach. But no matter how I look at it, between the ribs seems the more effective route... Either way, it does make things easier when your remove your ~clothing~ first.
I’ve seen plenty of Gorons shirtless... Zora, too. But a more human-like chest like yours is actually something of a rarity for me...
Wow… ~Name~ cuts a truly regal figure.
Mmmm... You have my stamp of approval.
I’m trying to find the words... but the only one that springs to mind is "yum."
I shan't presume to speak for everyone... But at the very least, this princess is pleased.
~Name~’s chest… This truly is a wonderful prize!
